tool_calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader

root = Path.cwd()
files = ["mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"]
baseline = root / ".ai/task/repair-w66-20261005/baseline"
workset = json.loads((root / ".ai/task/repair-w66-20261005/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
new_targets = json.loads((root / ".ai/task/repair-w66-20261005/NEW-TARGETS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
manifest = load_manifest()
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))

items_by_identity = {item["entry_revision_identity"]: item for item in workset}
changed = {}
loaded_counts = {}
for name in files:
    old_doc = loader.load_path(baseline / name, logical_path=f"baseline/{name}")
    new_doc = loader.load_path(root / name, logical_path=name)
    old_records = list(old_doc.records)
    new_records = list(new_doc.records)
    assert len(old_records) == len(new_records), (name, len(old_records), len(new_records))
    loaded_counts[name] = len(new_doc.translations)
    for old, new in zip(old_records, new_records):
        old_core = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k not in {"line", "logical_path", "target"}}
        new_core = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k not in {"line", "logical_path", "target"}}
        assert old_core == new_core, (name, "non-target record change", old_core, new_core)
        if old.get("target") != new.get("target"):
            matches = [item for item in workset if item["normalized_path"] == name and item["section"] == old.get("section") and item["source"] == old.get("source") and item.get("source_tag") == old.get("source_tag") and item.get("args_order") == old.get("args_order") and item["target_preimage"] == old.get("target")]
            assert len(matches) == 1, (name, "changed record not uniquely in workset", len(matches), old.get("section"), old.get("source"))
            identity = matches[0]["entry_revision_identity"]
            assert identity not in changed, identity
            changed[identity] = new.get("target")

assert set(changed) == set(items_by_identity), (len(changed), sorted(set(items_by_identity) - set(changed)), sorted(set(changed) - set(items_by_identity)))
replacements = {
    "201a4359ecaa658001e80ac1f08f2c0690a0045082ecab98482ebd6f295b0e14": ("也只有在那时我使用了这个咒语，使暴民们的生命全部枯萎，并将它们转移到克里尔·费扬体内。", "直到那时我才动用它，一举令暴民们全部枯萎，并将他们的生命强行注入克里尔·费扬体内。"),
    "a4ad61026b7ca1ba10908db3ed7207ad7f4611ca7a09af5c8cc4c7350adf6b3b": ("主要防御力量被击退，应急部队遭受严重损失。计划完全失败。", "主要防御部队被击退，第二支队伍伤亡惨重。一切都完了。"),
    "bb15e6ad6ea81fc1611910790096ec25e49a2ed16214d0829b56ffdbf615640f": ("曾无数次直面灭族危机，", "曾无数次直面几乎注定的死亡，"),
}
for identity, actual in changed.items():
    expected = new_targets[identity]["new_target"]
    if identity in replacements:
        before, after = replacements[identity]
        assert expected.count(before) == 1, (identity, "round-3 preimage count", expected.count(before))
        expected = expected.replace(before, after)

root = Path.cwd()

items_by_identity = {item["entry_revision_identity"]: item for item in workset}

for name in files:
    old_doc = loader.load_path(baseline / name, logical_path=f"baseline/{name}")
    new_doc = loader.load_path(root / name, logical_path=name)
    old_records = list(old_doc.records)
    new_records = list(new_doc.records)
    assert len(old_records) == len(new_records), (name, len(old_records), len(new_records))

            identity = matches[0]["entry_revision_identity"]

assert set(changed) == set(items_by_identity), (len(changed), sorted(set(items_by_identity) - set(changed)), sorted(set(changed) - set(items_by_identity)))
